payload.reason: The evidence indicates that additional fine-tuning on CLIP was not included in the experiments because it consistently performed worse than using extracted features for classification, likely due to the small size of the labeled dataset.

claims.text: Fine-tuning CLIP with a classification head performed worse than using extracted features for classification with SVM.
The poor performance of fine-tuning CLIP is attributed to the relatively smaller sized labeled dataset, which is insufficient for effective fine-tuning.
